macro.text: Bond yields posted their biggest surge since 2022 on growing bets for more Fed rate hikes
Gold languished near a 13-month low as oil near $96 fueled bigger Fed-hike bets
Oil traded mixed near $96, up on Iran blockade talk but set for a second weekly decline
The yen slid toward 160, drawing fresh intervention threats
US-China tensions shifted ahead of next week's Trump-Xi summit

corporate.note: Cisco beat estimates and said AI infrastructure revenue will double this fiscal year
Stock fell over 4% after CEO Jensen Huang resigned; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
Singapore charged a fifth person in an ongoing Nvidia chip export probe
Cerebras shares jumped 17% on a revenue beat and a new Microsoft deal after prior Amazon/Oracle tie-ups
A widespread outage knocked out Outlook, Teams and other 365 services
Centuri Holdings director Carl Icahn sold $30.1 million of shares
Matador Resources' chairman and CEO bought $123,225 of stock
Warner Bros. Discovery insider David Kustoff sold shares
Globalstar's general counsel and CFO both sold stock, totaling over $2.2 million combined

frontPage.watch: Watch PPI and jobless claims at 17:30 ET alongside how markets digest the Nvidia leadership vacuum and rising rate-hike odds.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3738 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.843 + 0.972×ln(VIX) + 0.314×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
